entries.title: Vector and scalar fields
entries.description: Show local field direction, magnitude, potential and gradients in a shared coordinate system; relate sample vectors to the scalar landscape.
entries.provenance: Original authoring method grounded in installed animlib contracts; primary scientific references and input requirements recorded in its document (checked 2026-10-14).
limitations: No Maxwell, fluid or PDE solver; provide the field and boundary conditions.
Normalized arrows discard magnitude unless separately encoded.

entries.title: Waves and complex interference
entries.description: Add complex wave amplitudes before deriving intensity, preserving each source phase and the visible cause of constructive or destructive interference.
entries.provenance: Original authoring method grounded in installed animlib contracts; primary scientific references and input requirements recorded in its document (checked 2026-10-14).
limitations: Computed squared amplitude is not calibrated irradiance or automatically normalized quantum probability.
No diffraction or wave-equation solver; supply frequencies, wave vectors and phases.

entries.title: Mechanical vibration and modal superposition
entries.description: Combine supplied mode shapes and frequencies into one displacement and velocity state for coupled oscillators, beams and engineering vibration.
entries.provenance: Original authoring method grounded in installed animlib contracts; primary scientific references and input requirements recorded in its document (checked 2026-10-14).
limitations: No eigenproblem, damping, forcing or finite-element solver is supplied by modalState.
Mode shapes and frequencies must be supplied or calculated separately; exaggeration needs a label.

entries.title: Dynamics and phase portraits
entries.description: Explain state-space flow, equilibria and trajectories using one explicit vector field and verified analytic or sampled solutions.
entries.provenance: Original authoring method grounded in installed animlib contracts; primary scientific references and input requirements recorded in its document (checked 2026-10-14).
limitations: No general ODE solver or stability inference; trajectory samples require independent validation.
Display interpolation is not a numerical integration method.

entries.title: Signals, Fourier components and reconstruction
entries.description: Build a signal from supplied frequencies, complex coefficients and a shared time cursor; reveal how each harmonic changes the same reconstruction.
entries.provenance: Original authoring method grounded in installed animlib contracts; primary scientific references and input requirements recorded in its document (checked 2026-10-14).
limitations: No FFT, coefficient fitting or filter-design engine; coefficients or validated samples are inputs.
A finite harmonic sum and a sampled signal have distinct truncation and aliasing limits.

entries.title: Ray optics and geometric correspondence
entries.description: Construct incident, reflected and refracted rays from a shared interface normal and supplied refractive indices, with locally attached angles.
entries.provenance: Original authoring method grounded in installed animlib contracts; primary scientific references and input requirements recorded in its document (checked 2026-10-14).
limitations: No general ray tracer, lens optimizer or wave-optics solver.
Geometrical rays do not establish diffraction, polarization or calibrated power.

entries.title: Circuit state and charge-flow explanations
entries.description: Synchronize an authored circuit diagram, capacitor voltage, current and time trace from a supplied circuit solution.
entries.provenance: Original authoring method grounded in installed animlib contracts; primary scientific references and input requirements recorded in its document (checked 2026-10-14).
limitations: No SPICE, schematic parser or circuit solver; supply topology, values and a verified solution.
Moving charge markers are schematic, not literal drift velocity or electromagnetic propagation.

entries.title: Elastic deformation and stress correspondence
entries.description: Show an explicit displacement field on retained geometry while tying strain, force and supplied stress data to the same material points.
entries.provenance: Original authoring method grounded in installed animlib contracts; primary scientific references and input requirements recorded in its document (checked 2026-10-14).
limitations: No constitutive, finite-element or failure solver; deformation alone does not determine stress.
Fixed topology only; fracture, remeshing and contact need separate prepared geometry.

entries.title: Probability distributions and Bayesian updating
entries.description: Expose sample space, conditioning and normalization with shared probability masses or supplied densities, then derive the updated distribution.
entries.provenance: Original authoring method grounded in installed animlib contracts; primary scientific references and input requirements recorded in its document (checked 2026-10-14).
limitations: No statistical fitting or inference engine; provide hypotheses, prior, likelihood and assumptions.
Density height is not probability; interval mass requires integration or declared approximation.

entries.title: Reaction stoichiometry and conservative transport
entries.description: Track conserved quantities through explicit compartments and transfer events; keep chemical stoichiometry separate from assumed kinetic rates.
entries.provenance: Original authoring method grounded in installed animlib contracts; primary scientific references and input requirements recorded in its document (checked 2026-10-14).
limitations: Conservative transfer is not a chemical-reaction solver and does not infer rate laws from stoichiometry.
Molecule counts need not be conserved by reactions; choose elemental mass or other valid conserved quantities.

entries.title: Ecological stocks and compartment flows
entries.description: Explain transfers among explicit ecological reservoirs with stable stock identities, consistent units and an auditable conservation ledger.
entries.provenance: Original authoring method grounded in installed animlib contracts; primary scientific references and input requirements recorded in its document (checked 2026-10-14).
limitations: No ecosystem prediction, birth/death model or calibration; assumptions and external reservoirs must be supplied.
Conservation only applies to the declared closed quantity, not all biological counts or energy availability.

entries.title: Orbital motion and swept-area reasoning
entries.description: Keep position, velocity and swept areas tied to one verified orbit with an explicit origin, frame, units and time parameter.
entries.provenance: Original authoring method grounded in installed animlib contracts; primary scientific references and input requirements recorded in its document (checked 2026-10-14).
limitations: No N-body propagator or ephemeris downloader; use verified analytic motion or prepared state samples.
Uniform motion around an ellipse does not demonstrate equal areas in equal times.

entries.title: Terrain, scalar maps and cross-sections
entries.description: Relate sampled elevation or scalar values to a surface, selected cross-section and locally marked contour under an explicit coordinate transform.
entries.provenance: Original authoring method grounded in installed animlib contracts; primary scientific references and input requirements recorded in its document (checked 2026-10-14).
limitations: No GIS raster reader, reprojection, erosion or flood solver; prepare a selected bounded grid on the host.
Smoothing and vertical exaggeration alter the visible geometry and must be disclosed.

entries.title: Neural events, rates and projected state
entries.description: Link spike events to bounded kernel-rate estimates and projected population trajectories while preserving channel, time and averaging meaning.
entries.provenance: Original authoring method grounded in installed animlib contracts; primary scientific references and input requirements recorded in its document (checked 2026-10-14).
limitations: Kernel rates are smoothing estimates, not recovered latent states or evidence of causation.
A supplied projection is not a learned neural manifold; bandwidth and time units must be explicit.
